clips.title: The story
paras: The Ruins of Constellas are the shattered remnants of an ancient night elf settlement in Felwood, nestled near the roots of Mount Hyjal. Today, the once-sacred grounds are overrun by the Jadefire satyrs, who have violently profaned the settlement's moonwell with demonic fel magic.

The classical stone arches and crumbling plazas of Constellas reveal that this was once an idyllic night elven community. During the Third War, the Burning Legion's march through Felwood shattered the haven, leaving it exposed to lingering demonic corruption. Now, the foul Jadefire satyrs hold dominion over the stones. Led by Xavathras, they actively tend to a defiled moonwell, transforming pure waters into a font of noxious fel power on behalf of their master, Lord Xavaric.

The defilement of Constellas weighs heavily on all who would heal Felwood. To those working to cleanse the forest, Xavathras and his Jadefire are among its foulest corrupters, and the satyrs fiercely guard their tents among the ruins and the tainted moonwell at their heart against any who come to end their work.
